$Comment: The critical chance on the carrier's direct Arcane hits alone, in whole percent points (10 is 10% more chance), added to CritChance in ziggfreed-common's crit step on a hit whose damage cause is Arcane or inherits from it: a school's crit talent keeps to its element. Any item's StatModifiers, an effect's RawStatModifiers or a pick's grant raise it like any stat. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
